name: com.geopagespeed/scanner
title: GeoPageSpeed
description: Check if ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI can reach, read and quote a web page.

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page once (no JavaScript, like most AI crawlers) and return the GeoPageSpeed report in Markdown: the score, top fixes, AI crawler access, and every check with its status, evidence tier and fix. Takes about 5 seconds.

url.description: The page to scan, e.g. https://example.com/pricing

page_type.description: Override the detected page type. Leave out to detect it.

tools.name: explain_check
tools.description: What one GeoPageSpeed check tests, its evidence tier, how it counts in the score, how to fix a failure, and its sources. Takes a check ID from a report, e.g. crawl.ai_search_bots_allowed.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Every check GeoPageSpeed runs, grouped by module, with its ID, title and evidence tier.
